meta.title: Vedic astrology tools and trusted astrologers
meta.description: Free kundli, matchmaking and panchang tools computed from an astronomical ephemeris, with vetted astrologers when you want to talk it through.

home.heading: Clear answers from your birth chart
home.lede: Every planetary position, tithi and nakshatra on this site is calculated from astronomical data for your exact place and time. We explain what it means in plain language, and you can talk to a vetted astrologer whenever you want more depth.

kundli.title: Birth chart
kundli.body: Your chart in North or South Indian style, with planets, houses and dasha periods.

matching.title: Kundli matching
matching.body: All eight kootas scored out of 36, with dosha checks explained koota by koota.

panchang.title: Daily panchang
panchang.body: Tithi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset and Rahu Kaal for your city, in your city's time zone.

principles.computed: Astrological values come from the calculation engine, never from guesswork or AI.
principles.labelled: Anything written by AI is labelled as AI. It is never presented as a person.
principles.honest: No countdown timers, no fake online counts, no fear-based offers.

home.status: We are building this now. The tools above open soon.

footer.dataCredits: Astronomical calculations: Swiss Ephemeris (AGPL). Place data © GeoNames, CC-BY 4.0.

cta.heading: Want to talk it through with an astrologer?
cta.body: The calculations above are exact, but what they mean for your life is a conversation. We are bringing vetted astrologers onto the platform, each checked for identity, qualifications and experience.
cta.status: Consultations are open. Chat with astrologers who offer chat, and call those who take voice calls where calls are available. Each profile shows what the astrologer offers. No astrologer profiles are shown until they are real and verified.
